seed_algorithm: Scalar and shape draws: first 8 bytes, big endian, of SHA-256 over compact JSON [2, seed, identity, field]. Fixed-leaf mode uses global leaf IDs; fixed-parent mode uses (parent_id << 32) + child_position. Values are independent of RNG call order.

filter.semantics: Flatten leaves; count and sum amount >= 50. Empty sum is null.

join.semantics: Flatten leaves, join parents by parent_id, exclude null amounts, group by bucket; return count and sum.

topn.semantics: Flatten leaves; per parent order non-null amounts descending, leaf_id ascending; sum up to two. Omit parents without non-null amounts.

transform.semantics: Flatten leaves; select amount >= 50, double amount, retain tag and padding, reconstruct leaf_id/adjusted/tag/padding arrays ordered by leaf_id per parent. Omit parents without selected leaves.

comparison: Exact integers, nulls and nested values; ordered result rows and arrays. Each depth retains the complete leaf bag and parent membership.
padding_algorithm: High entropy: concatenate SHA-256 hex blocks over UTF-8 Python json.dumps([2, data_seed, leaf_id, "padding", block]) with default separators; block indices start at zero. Truncate to width characters. Low entropy: repeat x.
